test_conditions: Invented A/B/C electrolyte conductivity; Arrhenius model over −20 to 80 °C. Geometry/contact uncertainties absent because this is not an impedance measurement.

reference.observation: Conductivity and Arrhenius expression; no activation energy inferred in this demo
reference.review_scope: publisher text/caption; no numerical data or original artwork copied

reproduce: python render_specialist.py --recipe ionic_conductivity --input-folder ionic_conductivity --output-dir brf-output --style forge
creator: BatteryReviewForge original synthetic model and drawing

equations: stored conductivity_mS_cm=1000*sigma_S_cm; Arrhenius axes are ln(sigma_S_cm) and 1000/T_K
assumptions: Single thermally activated transport law, constant prefactor and Ea within the stated range.

references.title: IUPAC: Arrhenius equation
references.supports: Exponential temperature law; original conductivity prefactors and energies.

limitations: No VTF behavior, phase transition, contact/geometry uncertainty or measured conductivity claim.
Input Ea is known by construction and is not an experimentally fitted activation energy.
scientific_basis.validation_scope: Declared teaching model and internal relationships only; no experimental or material certification.
